items.q: Which servers will be available to me?
items.a: Currently you can choose from servers in the following countries: France, United Kingdom, Poland, United States, Iraq, Russia, Germany, and Netherlands. Automatic selection of the best server is also available.

items.q: What payment methods are available for the VPN?
items.a: You can pay with a VISA, Mastercard, or MIR bank card, with cryptocurrency via Tribute, or with Telegram Stars.

items.q: Will my internet provider know that I'm using a VPN?
items.a: Your provider will see a connection to a VPN but won't be able to track your traffic.

items.q: Do you keep logs of user activity?
items.a: No. We do not store the history of visited websites, IP addresses, or online actions.

items.q: Can I use the VPN on several devices at the same time?
items.a: Yes, one configuration file can be used on up to 10 devices simultaneously.
